theme.title: The Big Three's first year
theme.subtitle: Boston, 2007–08
theme.recap: Boston went from a franchise-worst losing streak to 66 wins and a title won with a 39-point clincher.

questions.prompt: After adding Kevin Garnett and Ray Allen, how many games did the 2007–08 Celtics win?

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: the trade enabled the Celtics to finish the season with a record of 66–16

questions.prompt: A year before their title, the 2006–07 Celtics set a franchise record with a losing streak of how many games?

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: culminated in a 24-win 2006–07 season, highlighted by a franchise-worst 18 straight losses

questions.prompt: Boston needed a record number of playoff games to win the 2008 title. How many?

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: the Celtics set an NBA record for most playoff games ever needed to win a championship, with 26

questions.prompt: Boston won the 2008 title-clinching Game 6 against the Lakers by how many points?

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: The 39-point margin of victory was the largest ever in an NBA championship-clinching game

questions.prompt: Reserve Leon Powe played only 15 minutes in Game 2 of the 2008 Finals. How many points did he score?

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Leon Powe scored 21 points on 6–7 shooting from the field and 9–13 from the line in 15 minutes of play
